messages:
noah: Heads-up — I ran a quick pass on onboarding Onyx-7B for our catalog. Need a triage thread: quant benches, quality checks, and release/docs coordination. Starting notes below.

sam: I ran microbench + perf sweep across Q4_0 / Q4_1 / int8 on p4d. Results short summary: Q4_0 latency down ~1.8x vs fp16, throughput +70%. int8 slightly faster but unstable for long contexts. Raw run: 
```
./bench --model onyx-7b --quant Q4_0 --batch 8 --seq 512
=> latency 42ms/token, p95 110ms, tokens/sec 1120
```
More detail in the artifact link: https://ci.redwood/bench/onyx-7b/17609

morgan: Quality note: we saw a small regression on LAMBADA and some summarization fuzziness vs our baseline 7B. Aggregate rouge drop ~0.8 points. Not huge but noticeable on prompts with long-range dependencies. I’ve attached eval snippets in the eval harness.

noah: Thanks. Can you paste the failing example(s)? We need to decide whether the regression is acceptable for hosted tier or requires model adjustments / different quant profile.

morgan: Example (short):
Input: "In 1912 the ship ___ sank after hitting an iceberg."
Gold: "Titanic"
Onyx-Q4_0: "The ship sank after colliding with ice." (missed named entity)
Also a summarization case where the model drops a clause. Seems tied to tokenization edge-case + quantized kv-cache attenuation.

sam: I re-ran with KV cache disabled — regression persists, so likely representational. But switching to Q4_1 reduces the miss rate while keeping most perf gains. Q4_1 latency ~48ms/token. Trade-off: ~14% perf hit vs Q4_0 but better quality.

tanya: On infra side I ran dedicated pool soak. With Q4_0 we hit lower mem pressure but observed occasional OOMs on batched long-context sessions due to slightly different allocation patterns in the quant kernel. Q4_1 is more conservative. I’ll open an infra ticket: INFRA-729.

noah: So options: 1) Catalog: onboard as beta with Q4_1 as default quant profile + Q4_0 opt-in for advanced users (clear warning); 2) Hold until we reduce quality drift; 3) Add automatic fallback to fp16 on failing evals. Preference?

maya: Product: leaning to option 1 (beta) with explicit notes and example failure modes in model card. We can gate marketing and enterprise availability until we hit parity. Need docs + changelog + brief announce.

jade: I can draft model card and onboarding docs. Need the canonical quant config, recommended max context, rate-limit guidance, and known regressions. Please drop the example failures and the exact config we want surfaced. Also need a short blurb for the Catalog UI: "Onyx-7B (Quantized Q4_1 default) — beta."

sam: Recommended surfaced config: 
```json
{"quant_profile": "Q4_1", "max_context": 2048, "batch_sizes": [1,4,8], "fallback": "fp16_on_quality_fail"}
```
Also add: experimental flag for q4_0: "quant=Q4_0_experimental"

morgan: I'll push a minimal eval suite (lambada, summarization set, code-completion) as linear tests. If any test fails threshold -> mark candidate as regressed. Thresholds: lambada acc drop >0.5% or rouge drop >0.5 is a regression.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline status: onyx-7b/quant-sweep job finished — 8 artifacts uploaded. Stage: pre-release checks passed (except INFRA-729 flagged).

tanya: INFRA-729: noting stack traces and exact workloads that triggered OOMs. Mitigation in prod: quota per route + hard limit on pooled batch size for Q4_0. We should not let Q4_0 be default on hosted.

noah: Plan proposal: onboard to model catalog as "Onyx-7B (beta)" with default Q4_1. Provide an advanced toggle for Q4_0 (opt-in) with explicit warning and per-customer quota. Run a 48h canary on hosted with synthetic traffic and our eval harness; if no further regressions, promote. Docs + model card + release note to be prepared today.

maya: Timeline OK. Marketing will not push a major announcement; just a product update banner and changelog entry. Enterprise sales will be notified by SEs as "beta release".

jade: I'll have a draft model card + quickstart ready in ~4 hours. Need the exact canary policy wording (what triggers rollback).

noah: Canary policy draft: auto-rollback if any of the following during 48h canary: (a) lambada acc drop >0.7% vs baseline, (b) sustained p95 text-gen latency >150ms for 1h, (c) any OOM in production pool. Otherwise auto-promote.

sam: Running final sweep to collect 48h synthetic canary numbers now. ETA ~36h for full run. Will push interim numbers into the artifact link.

morgan: I'll wire the eval harness to the canary so results are continuously reported to the regressions dashboard.

jade: Great — once I have the examples and the config JSON I can fill out the model catalog entry fields and the docs page.

noah: Nice work team. Action items: sam -> finish sweep + upload; morgan -> attach failing examples + hook eval to canary; tanya -> infra mitigations + ticket updates; jade -> draft model card & quickstart; maya -> coordinate product messaging. We’ll reconvene after the 36h interim results. :thumbsup:

morgan: FYI attaching minimal failing examples here: https://evals.redwood/onyx-7b/failures/17609

sam: Interim perf snapshot uploaded: https://ci.redwood/bench/onyx-7b/17609/interim

noah: Logging this thread to the onboarding tracker: /onboard Onyx-7B Q4_1-beta. Will update ticket with final decision.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please include the model-card PR link in the release checklist to unblock the catalog publish.
